text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to inquire about hiring the 1963 Tindall Skylark for a commercial shoot that I have been scheduled for on 29 June 2027, from 2 pm until 5:00 pm. The vehicle will be needed at Villa Rosalinda, where it should be available for collection after the shoot.

Please note that I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Yours sincerely,
Greta Marrowby
+70 339 642 8974
